source.title: H2O-Danube-1.8B Technical Report
source.authors: Philipp Singer; Pascal Pfeiffer; Yauhen Babakhin; Maximilian Jeblick; Nischay Dhankhar; Gabor Fodor; SriSatish Ambati

record.tranche_reason: The paper reports a validation cross-entropy training curve against tokens for one model, but does not fit or evaluate a scaling law.
record.gate_note: Figure 1 reports validation cross-entropy over training tokens, so it bears on V1. The paper does not report parameter- or compute-scaling sweeps, power-law fits, extrapolation tests, or a compute-optimal allocation analysis. Benchmark comparisons are not tests of downstream predictability.
record.test_reason: A technical report for one 1.8B model. It cites Kaplan et al. only in the introduction and fits no scaling law. It runs no sweep over parameters, tokens or compute, and tests no extrapolation, allocation, shape or downstream predictability. Its single validation-loss training curve (Figure 1) is figure-only, mixes in learning-rate schedule and sequence-length changes, and cannot show power-law behaviour. The comparison of benchmarks across models of different token counts is incidental, not a test of predictability.
record.authors_conclusion: Correct. The authors present H2O-Danube-1.8B (1T tokens) and Danube2 (another 2T tokens) as competitive open small models, with chat variants. They draw no scaling-law conclusions.
record.recipe_differences: A single-model training-loss curve is reported rather than scaling-law fitting across model sizes, token budgets, or compute budgets.
record.method_sensitivity: Training sequence length changes over the token schedule; no effect of that schedule on the loss curve is described.
record.problems: The relevant loss result is figure-only, with no numerical values, uncertainty, or stated curve shape; only one model trajectory is shown.
record.rows_left_out: No other results bear directly on the listed versions. The benchmark tables compare models but do not test downstream predictability with scale or pretraining loss.

untested.parts: All of it: no parameter, token or compute sweep and no power-law fit.
All of it. Small-model (≤500M) hyperparameter experiments are mentioned but not reported.

record.verdict_notes: The reader's 'tests/T2' should be changed: a single training curve is not a test of any version. The informal remark that Qwen and StableLM 2 used more tokens is a benchmark comparison confounded by data differences, not a scaling analysis.

versions.untested_parts: The figure covers one model's training-token trajectory only; it does not test a power-law fit, parameter or compute scaling, or whether the other quantities are non-bottlenecks.

rows.subject: H2O-Danube-1.8B
rows.operation_detail: Validation cross-entropy logged over training tokens during pretraining.
rows.note: The text identifies the plot as validation cross-entropy against the number of tokens trained, but provides no numeric values or description of the curve's shape.
rows.check: This is one model's training-loss log, not a scaling measurement. It is confounded by the cosine LR schedule and sequence-length switches, and it has no numbers and no fit, so it cannot bear on V1.

source_check.scope: Only the listed rows, labels and statements were checked; presence is not whole-study approval.
